instruction: Use command-line automation through the installed SOLIDWORKS CAM 2025 environment and CAMWorks API; do not use GUI clicks, generic G-code generators, or manual .nc editing/copying. On this machine, SOLIDWORKS CAM/CAMWorks is hosted by `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\SLDWORKS.exe`; run the native CAM automation through that installation. Load C:\Users\User\Desktop\shaft_family.step and read C:\Users\User\Desktop\tools.csv. Create a turning setup and complete OD roughing, OD finishing, two grooving operations, and end-face center drilling using the supplied turning tool data. Save the posted NC output exactly as C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-11.nc.
